connector.name: Dead Simple Email
connector.registryDescription: Give an agent its own inbox: send, receive, and pull signup codes from real email.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.deadsimple.email over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package deadsimple-email. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace email.deadsimple, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer dse_your_api_key. Get one instantly with no signup form: POST https://api.deadsimple.email/v1/auth/agent-signup

env.name: DSE_API_KEY
env.description: Dead Simple Email API key (starts with dse_). Get one instantly with no signup form: POST https://api.deadsimple.email/v1/auth/agent-signup
